prompt: On a ride card, one cyclist writes only this: 'I’d go back to the market.' What should the volunteer find out before counting that reply as support for the narrow lane?
promptZh: 有位騎士在騎乘意見卡上只寫了：「我還會再去市集。」要把這當成支持窄巷路線的回覆之前，志工應確認什麼？
evidence: “We want to find out whether people can use the public pump without us, and which parts of the ride they’d choose again.” / “Some riders said they loved the market, but wouldn’t ride down the narrow lane again.” / “The river path takes people to that same market.” / “So, write down the path each person actually rode, and ask them to mark the stretches they would ride again.” / “Don’t ask for one rating for the whole outing.”
explanationZh: 窄巷和河濱路都能到市集，想再去市集既不能證明走了窄巷，也不能證明喜歡那個路段，要分開核實。

options.text: Whether the rider took the lane and gave the whole outing a good rating
options.zh: 騎士是不是走窄巷，並給整趟出遊好評。
options.whyZh: 確認是哪條路有幫助，但整趟好評仍可能只是喜歡市集，不能證明騎士想再走窄巷。

options.text: Whether the rider would consider trying the lane, even if they took a different path
options.zh: 騎士是否願意考慮試走窄巷，即使當天走的是另一條路。
options.whyZh: 想試走和實際騎過後願意再騎不同；講者要根據實際路線收集意見。

options.text: Whether the rider actually took the lane and would choose to ride that stretch again
options.zh: 騎士實際走的是否為窄巷，而且會不會選擇再騎那個路段。
options.whyZh: 窄巷和河濱路都能到市集，想再去市集既不能證明走了窄巷，也不能證明喜歡那個路段，要分開核實。

options.text: Whether the rider used the river path and would visit the market again
options.zh: 騎士是否走了河濱路線，而且還想再去市集。
options.whyZh: 河濱路也可去市集，這只能說明目的地受歡迎或有人走了另一條路，不能算作支持實際騎過的窄巷路段。
